_about: Local businesses (not chains) with a military discount, for the app's Near me map. Each one was checked by hand on the business's own website: 'quote' is the sentence found there on the 'checked' date, and recheck.py looks for it again every month (a shop whose page stops showing it two months running leaves the map). Positions come from OpenStreetMap by ID ('osm') at each store-list build. Hotel and resort room rates, online-only codes, one-day offers (Veterans Day), and on-base exchanges and MWR are left out.
